name: Ended of Justify Lylera Secret
description: ARA 2026 / Ended of Justify Lylera Secret: User-controlled data is rendered as template source instead of being passed as template context, allowing expression evaluation in the template engine. Injection type is Template Injection. Attack surface: user-supplied strings rendered back into the page: names, messages, error text, preview or profile fields. Recommended strategy: The route calls ejs.render(template, query, query): the request query object is passed as both the data and the options argument. EJS option keys such as outputFunctionName, escapeFunction and the client/filename pair are compiled into the generated function body, so a crafted query parameter breaks out of the template and executes JavaScript in the Node process. The catch block also echoes the exception, which gives a convenient output channel.
vuln_type: EJS options injection leading to RCE (ejs.render with user-controlled options)
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves. Difficulty Medium-Hard (4) because the primitive is blind or heavily filtered and requires an oracle plus a gadget chain. Impact 9.5 because expression evaluation typically escalates to sandbox escape and arbitrary code execution.
